reason: Critical runnability gaps remain: Simulation.run() is missing, _host_contacts_and_transmissions is incomplete and does not return on all paths, and main() is empty. Without these, the simulation cannot execute or produce metrics. With only three iterations left, the next iteration should focus on making the simulation runnable end-to-end, aligning APIs, and updating series. These changes are high-impact and feasible within one iteration.

specific_areas: Implement Simulation.run() with a daily loop: policy step, media broadcasts (with time), mask replacement and purchasing, wearing decisions and enforcement, peer belief updates, attendance generation, contacts and transmissions, disease progression, and series updates

Complete Simulation._host_contacts_and_transmissions to filter attendees by enforcement, compute per-location adoption, simulate contacts using self.nprg.poisson, apply DiseaseProcess.transmit_given_contact, and return (new_infections_today, adoption_by_loc_type)
Implement main() to instantiate Simulation, call run(), and print or return a minimal summary for smoke testing
Update MediaOutlet.broadcast call sites to include t and configured media_effect_weight
Remove placeholder loop in _init_locations and rely on households to build homes
Ensure all time series are appended daily and lengths equal simulation_days
Unify RNG usage across the loop (use self.rng/self.nprg only; no bare numpy.random)
Add minimal evaluate() to compute summary KPIs (final adoption, average price, Gini, cumulative infections) for quick validation
Adjust type annotations for Optional[np.random.Generator]/Optional[random.Random] in Retailer and guard usages
Add basic import error handling or clear dependency message for numpy/networkx
Add a simple deterministic smoke test in main() with a fixed seed and print final_adoption for verification
